categories.title: Longest ramps and connections
categories.intro: The longest stretches of road among the drawings shown here.
categories.definition: Distance along the road, measured from one end of the drawing to the other.
categories.note: Some drawings include a road shared by several ramps. Length follows the full line shown.
categories.technical_definition: Sum of the lengths of every original centerline segment, in US survey feet.

categories.title: Shortest pieces
categories.intro: Small forks and short connections, seen on their own.
categories.definition: The same distance used for Longest ramps and connections, ordered from shortest to longest.
categories.note: Some drawings show just one piece of a longer ramp.
categories.technical_definition: The same centerline length as Longest paths, sorted from shortest to longest.

categories.title: Most twists and turns
categories.intro: The drawings with the most bending from start to finish.
categories.definition: Adds up all the changes in direction along the road. This measures the shape, rather than the number of turns a driver makes.
categories.note: Every bend counts, whether it turns left or right.
categories.technical_definition: Sum of absolute heading changes between consecutive, nonzero source line segments, in degrees.

categories.title: Most winding
categories.intro: The most bending over the same amount of road.
categories.definition: Total turning divided by road length, compared over 100 feet.
categories.note: Short pieces can rank highly here. The comparison looks at turning per 100 feet.
categories.technical_definition: Total absolute heading change divided by selected length, multiplied by 100 feet.

categories.title: Tightest curves
categories.intro: A closer look at the sharpest bends in the drawings.
categories.definition: The estimated radius of the tightest bend, using the project’s existing 100-foot comparison. A smaller radius means a sharper curve.
categories.note: These are estimates from the road map. A smaller number means a tighter curve.
categories.technical_definition: Minimum modeled local radius from the earlier analytics file’s 100-foot moving-window calculation. This precomputed measure is retained unchanged.

categories.title: The long way around
categories.intro: Roads that cover a lot of ground while ending close to where they began.
categories.definition: Compares distance along the road with a straight line between its ends. The straight line is a measuring aid, not another road.
categories.note: The dashed line joins the two ends of the drawing. A nearly closed loop can score very highly.
categories.technical_definition: Selected path length divided by the straight-line distance between its recorded endpoints.

categories.title: Widest shapes
categories.intro: The drawings that spread furthest from side to side.
categories.definition: The shorter side of a box around the road’s shape.
categories.note: This measures the shape’s spread, not the width of its lanes. The dashed box follows the angle of the shape.
categories.technical_definition: Shorter side of a principal-axis bounding box. Its axes come from the unweighted covariance of the original vertices.

categories.title: Longest spans
categories.intro: The drawings whose outlines stretch the furthest.
categories.definition: The longer side of the same box used for Widest shapes.
categories.note: This measures the long side of the dashed box. It is different from distance traveled along the curves.
categories.technical_definition: Longer side of the same principal-axis bounding box used for Broadest footprints.

categories.title: Biggest footprints
categories.intro: The shapes that fill the largest surrounding boxes.
categories.definition: The area of a box around the shape, in acres. One acre is 43,560 square feet.
categories.note: The box includes open space around the road. Its area is not the amount of pavement.
categories.technical_definition: Product of the two principal-axis box dimensions, converted from square feet to acres (43,560 square feet per acre).

categories.title: Straightest stretches
categories.intro: The most direct stretches of road at least 500 feet long.
categories.definition: Compares road length with the straight-line distance between its ends. Only drawings at least 500 feet long are included.
categories.note: The percentage shows how much longer the road is than a straight line between its ends.
categories.technical_definition: Lowest path-to-endpoint-chord ratio among selections with length of at least 500 feet. A ratio of one is perfectly straight.

categories.title: Most ramp shapes
categories.intro: The exits with the most individual drawings to explore.
categories.definition: Number of drawings at an exit after applying the current filters.
categories.note: This counts the drawings included here, including forks and shared connections. It is not a count of every physical ramp.
categories.technical_definition: Count of selected records in each interchange group after applying the current filters. Each group appears once.

categories.title: Most traffic · 2024
categories.intro: The highest average daily vehicle counts on the roads shown here.
categories.definition: Average vehicles per day on the road linked to this drawing, based on 2024 federal traffic estimates.
categories.note: Daily averages from 2024. Some drawings share a road count, and missing estimates are left out.
categories.technical_definition: 2024 FHWA HPMS AADT linked by exact road SRI and overlapping source mileage. 277 of 359 selected paths have a usable positive estimate.

categories.title: Least traffic · 2024
categories.intro: The lowest available average daily vehicle counts.
categories.definition: Average vehicles per day on the road linked to this drawing, ordered from lowest to highest.
categories.note: Daily averages from 2024. A missing estimate is left out, rather than counted as zero.
categories.technical_definition: 2024 FHWA HPMS AADT linked by exact road SRI and overlapping source mileage. 277 of 359 selected paths have a usable positive estimate.

categories.title: Busiest connections with tolls · 2024
categories.intro: Compare traffic on roads associated with a ramp toll.
categories.definition: Average vehicles per day in 2024 for drawings associated with a listed ramp toll.
categories.note: These are road traffic estimates, not counts of toll payments. Missing estimates are left out.
categories.technical_definition: 2024 FHWA HPMS AADT linked by exact road SRI and overlapping source mileage. 277 of 359 selected paths have a usable positive estimate.

categories.title: Quietest connections with tolls · 2024
categories.intro: The lowest available traffic estimates among connections with a ramp toll.
categories.definition: The same traffic measure as Busiest connections with tolls, ordered from lowest to highest.
categories.note: These are road traffic estimates, not counts of toll payments. Missing estimates are left out.
categories.technical_definition: 2024 FHWA HPMS AADT linked by exact road SRI and overlapping source mileage. 277 of 359 selected paths have a usable positive estimate.
